description: Complete inventory of all screens/pages in LyfeOS with component files, routes, implementation status, and provenance.

primary_pages.name: Dashboard
primary_pages.description: Home screen with XP progress, stat tokens, today's primary mission, streak counter, recent completions, vision goal progress, NOVA quick-access, daily boosts, and widget states.

primary_pages.name: Missions / Quests
primary_pages.description: Mission management with Board, List, and Calendar views. Search, sort, filter. Custom Notion-style views. Ritual groups, vision goal linking, difficulty ranks, repeat patterns, soft delete.

primary_pages.name: AI Companion
primary_pages.description: Chat interface with AI companion (default name NOVA). Dual model routing (Haiku/Sonnet), tool use, vision analysis, 16-domain knowledge base, conversation persistence, streaming SSE.

primary_pages.name: Chronilog
primary_pages.description: Daily logging and timeline. Energy log (wake/sleep/mental/physical/emotional), intention log (gratitude/goals/thoughts), data log (content/research/todos), research log (multi-entry), reflection log. Links to Document Vault.

primary_pages.name: Profile
primary_pages.description: Character sheet display. Archetype results, identity sections, personality, vision/goals, skills, projects, health, wealth, performance, style, history, systems/rituals, emotions/coping. Character affirmation.

secondary_pages.name: Document Vault
secondary_pages.description: Google Drive-style data organizer with nested folders, markdown documents, templates, media upload, and bidirectional sync (Google Drive, Obsidian, Evernote).

secondary_pages.name: Tracker
secondary_pages.description: Milestone analytics and vision goal progress tracking. Progress trackers with value/target/unit.

secondary_pages.name: Settings
secondary_pages.description: Profile settings, integration management, display preferences, notification config, AI companion name setting.

secondary_pages.name: Contacts
secondary_pages.description: CRM/rolodex for personal and professional contacts with 30+ fields per contact.

secondary_pages.name: Kanban
secondary_pages.description: Standalone project boards with customizable columns and task cards. Separate from Missions Board view.

secondary_pages.name: Media
secondary_pages.description: Photos and videos organized in albums with smart album rules, metadata, geolocation, and favorites.

secondary_pages.name: Spreadsheets
secondary_pages.description: User spreadsheets with JSON content storage, categories, and favorites.

secondary_pages.name: Canvases
secondary_pages.description: Whiteboard/canvas drawing tool with JSONB shape/connection/text storage.

secondary_pages.name: Graphs
secondary_pages.description: Node-link diagrams and visualizations with JSONB node/edge/styling storage.

special_pages.name: Onboarding
special_pages.description: 8-mission character creation wizard (missions 0-7). Archetype Calibration (54-question quiz), Identity, Personality, Vision/Goals, Learning/Skills, Projects/Creations, Body/Health, Wealth/Work.

special_pages.name: Login
special_pages.description: Authentication entry. Email/password login with optional Firebase OAuth (Google/Apple/Facebook). 2FA support.

special_pages.name: Register
special_pages.description: Account creation with terms acceptance, email verification flow.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Experience
special_pages.description: XP and level detail page with recharts visualizations, time range selectors, and AI-powered insights.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Health
special_pages.description: Health Points detail with historical data, charts, and AI insights.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Wealth
special_pages.description: Wealth Tokens detail with historical data, charts, and AI insights.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Efficiency
special_pages.description: Efficiency Score detail with daily performance tracking, charts, and AI insights.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Energy
special_pages.description: Energy Points detail with usage tracking, charts, and AI insights.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Time
special_pages.description: Time Tokens detail with allocation tracking, charts, and AI insights.

special_pages.name: Stat Detail — Attention
special_pages.description: Attention Tokens detail with focus tracking, charts, and AI insights.
